records.title: Nankai University Chinese Government Scholarship - Silk Road Program
records.deadline_display: Application Deadline: From now until May 18, 2026.
records.application_period: The 2026 Silk Road round accepted applications until 18 May 2026, with registration for awardees in early September 2026. The round is annual; the 2027 call had not been published as of 2026-10-04.

records.title: Danish Government Scholarship for Non-EU/EEA Full-Degree Students
records.official_source: Danish Ministry of Science, Higher Education and Digital Affairs (Study in Denmark)
records.deadline_display: The ministry publishes no deadline: 'The scholarships are administered by the Danish universities, who each select the students, who are awarded with a scholarship. For further information about the government scholarship, please consult the admission details of the higher education institution of your choice.' The deadline is therefore the admission deadline of the individual university.

records.title: COMSTECH Fellowships for Research and Trainings in Human Nutrition, Nutraceuticals and Food Sciences
records.official_source: OIC-COMSTECH (Ministerial Standing Committee on Scientific and Technological Cooperation of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation)
records.deadline_display: No closing date published; COMSTECH states 'COMSTECH will accept applications on a yearly basis' and that only 10 fellowships are awarded on a first-come, first-served basis
records.application_period: Yearly, on a first-come, first-served basis while places remain; 10 fellowships available. The official page shows Call Status: 'The call is currently open'.

records.deadline_display: Applications for the 2026/2027 postgraduate foreign scholarships opened on 13 April 2026 and closed on 30 April 2026; the call is issued annually, so the next round is expected in the first half of 2027
